With the CareLink™ Connect app, now you can remotely see their glucose levels and insulin pump information wherever you are, so you can know how they are doing.

The CareLink™ Connect app helps you quickly accomplish these tasks: 
Let you securely view glucose levels, graphs, and trends
Sends you high or low glucose levels notifications, so you can be informed and supportive
Shows you the status of the insulin pump system, for greater peace of mind

To remotely view pump system information, family members or friends need to install the CareLink™ Connect app on their compatible mobile device. Also, the person with diabetes needs a MiniMed™ 700-series insulin pump, the MiniMed™ Mobile app installed on a compatible mobile device, which then should be connected online to the CareLink™ software. To find a list of compatible devices, please visit your local Medtronic website. 

IMPORTANT NOTE: In order to receive real-time updates, the app needs to continuously receive data from the CareLink™ servers, and the insulin pump system needs to sync with the CareLink™ servers through the MiniMed™ Mobile app. The CareLink™ Connect app only works with the MiniMed™ 700-series insulin pump systems; it currently does not support other standalone CGM systems, MiniMed™ or Paradigm™ insulin pumps. 

The CareLink™ Connect app is intended to provide a secondary display of insulin pump and CGM (Continuous Glucose Monitoring) system data on a supported mobile device. CareLink™ Connect app is not intended to replace the real-time display of insulin pump or CGM data on the primary display device. All therapy decisions should be based on the primary display device.

CareLink™ Connect app is not intended to analyze or modify the insulin pump and CGM data that it receives. Nor is it intended to control any function of the insulin pump or CGM system to which it is connected. CareLink™ Connect app is not intended to receive information directly from the insulin pump or CGM system.

The «Rossmax healthstyle» gives you a clear overview about your health conditions anytime and anywhere. By syncing your measurements via Bluetooth, you can easily view your history for five different Rossmax products. 

With the «Rossmax healthstyle» you can manage your Blood Pressure, Blood Glucose, SpO2, Weight and Temperature all in one APP. Products are easily connected through Bluetooth and real-time data communication is only a click away.

Health Dashboard
Through charts and record lists, Rossmax healthstyle show you a complete picture of your health.
Blood pressure, pulse, body weight, body temperature, SpO2, blood vessel elasticity, blood glucose, and other basic data can be collected by the application and compatible measuring devices to calculate body fat percentage, skeletal muscle rate, visceral fat degree, BMI, BMR.

Health cloud
Measurement data is not only stored in smartphones but also protected by Rossmax. With Rossmax healthstyle, users can create their health accounts on the Rossmax Care Cloud.
Whether it's wireless collection through Rossmax healthstyle-compatible health equipment or manually entered measurement data from other devices, you can wirelessly sync and manage your health data with your consent.

Export Records
Export your measurement data to track your health or provide for doctors or caretakers.

Baby Measurement Mode
Weigh your child or pet in three simple steps. 

Caring friends
Not only care for yourself, but also your friends and family. With the consent of both parties, you can share your measurement data with your friends and family and track their health. Authorized personnel can view the authorizer's records and charts through the “Caring friends” feature, even if they are far away.

Con la App Mi Sanitas nuestros clientes pueden:  

 -  Pedir citas médicas, gestionarlas, reprogramarlas y cancelarlas
 -  Buscar médicos, hospitales, centros médicos o clínicas dentales
 -  Encontrar el centro de urgencia y especialista más cercano
 -  Consultar el histórico de visitas al médico y las citas pendientes
 -  Guardar médicos favoritos
 -  Consultar informes médicos, analíticas, radiografías, etc
 -  Subir informes de otros centros para tener toda la información de salud en un solo lugar
